picked.t: Vietnam Airlines to launch direct Da Nang-Singapore flights on Nov 17
picked.body: The route will be operated by Airbus A321 aircraft, with flights departing Da Nang at 3:00 p.m. and Singapore at 7:45 p.m. (local time). The national flag carrier currently operates 14 round-trip flights per week between Hanoi and Singapore and 21 between Ho Chi Minh City and Singapore. Vietnam Airlines said Singapore is a key Southeast Asian source market for international visitors to Vietnam, with arrivals rising 29.8% year on year in the first nine months of 2026. Da Nang is among the destinations attracting Singaporean visitors. Round-trip economy-class tickets are priced from VND5.266 million (US$203.77), inclusive of taxes and fees, excluding peak periods. Tickets will be on sale until Dec. 31, 2026, for travel from Nov. 17, 2026, to May 31, 2027. In 2026, Vietnam Airlines has expanded its international network with routes to Amsterdam, Colombo and Phuket. It has also announced plans to launch Hanoi-Ahmedabad flights on Nov. 3 and Hanoi-Hangzhou flights on Nov. 22.

picked.t: BigBang takes Hanoi fans down memory lane with two decades of hits
picked.body: The concert at My Dinh National Stadium marked the group's first performance in the Vietnamese capital and was part of its 20th-anniversary world tour. During a break in the show, leader G-Dragon looked back on the group's two-decade career. "A journey that changed everything began in 2006. And here we are in 2026, still together to celebrate these wonderful 20 years," he said. The members thanked fans for their continued support, saying their loyalty had made the concert possible. "Thank you for waiting so patiently!" G-Dragon said. G-Dragon, Taeyang and Daesung opened the concert with "Fantastic Baby," one of the group's biggest hits, which helped popularize a blend of electronic dance music and hip-hop in K-pop. Billboard previously credited the song's explosive energy with helping K-pop reach audiences beyond South Korea. The group kept the crowd energized with "Tonight," "Blue" and "Bad Boy" before each member took the stage for solo performances. Daesung entertained fans with humorous exchanges between songs, while Taeyang impressed with his energetic choreography. During "Bad," Taeyang sang while lying across the outstretched arms of his backup dancers. He later performed "Ringa Linga" wearing a fur coat as flames shot up from the stage. During "Live Fast Die Slow," he approached fans in different sections of the venue, drawing loud cheers. G-Dragon, the last member to perform solo, received the loudest cheers from fans. Wearing his signature beret and oversized jacket, he performed "Crayon," "Crooked" and "Power," songs exploring loneliness, personal struggles and his passion for music. After "Home Sweet Home," the group left the stage, but fans continued singing "Haru Haru" and chanting "One more time!" About 10 minutes later, BigBang returned for an encore featuring "Last Farewell" and "Feeling." The concert ended at 10:30 p.m. with "Still Life," released in 2022. The song reflects on youth, change and the group's ups and downs following years away from the spotlight. Even after the final song, many fans remained in their seats, singing familiar BigBang hits. Throughout the nearly three-hour concert, the members impressed with their stage presence, strong live vocals, energetic choreography and frequent interactions with the audience. During "Hands Up," Daesung repeatedly shouted, "Hanoi, put your hands up!" The members also greeted fans in Vietnamese, saying "Xin chao, Ha Noi" (Hello, Hanoi), and wished them an enjoyable evening. Lan Anh, 28, from Hanoi, had nearly lost her voice after hours of cheering with friends. "This is the first time I have seen them in person after years of watching them on television and phone screens," she said. "Each member's life and career has changed so much, but their old songs still bring back memories of their youth and ours." Elaborate stage effects were another highlight of the concert. Visual introductions between segments featured striking designs, while fireworks, pyrotechnics and bursts of flames accompanied many performances. At the end of G-Dragon's "Crayon," confetti filled the air as LED lighting effects swept across the audience for several minutes. According to organizers, the Hanoi stage was comparable in scale to the group's setup in Goyang, South Korea, measuring 64 meters wide. Two large LED screens flanked the main stage, while a 23-ton mobile LED display featured a diamond-shaped design and a synchronized multi-motor system that allowed it to move through programmed sequences. Large speaker systems were installed on specialized structures to deliver clear sound across different sections of the stadium. Renowned Vietnamese singer Tung Duong, who attended the concert, described it as a memorable event not only for K-pop fans but also for Vietnam's music industry. He praised the group's distinctive musical style, stage presence and individuality. "They are truly talented vocalists, not simply idols defined by choreography, fashion or stage technology," he said. "Each voice has its own character, but together they create a harmonious sound that is unmistakably BigBang." He also admired the group's confident, free-spirited performance style. He said singing, moving around the stage and interacting with tens of thousands of fans while maintaining energy and emotion throughout the show required considerable skill and experience. "That kind of excellence on stage does not come naturally. Behind it are talent, rigorous training and years of performance experience," he said.

picked.t: TikToker Mr Pips' girlfriend stashes 94 kg of gold from Vietnam's biggest forex scam
picked.body: Investigators found 94 kilograms of gold, including ingots, bars and more than 500 gold blister packs, worth a combined VND222 billion, at an apartment in Ho Chi Minh City belonging to his girlfriend, Nguyen Thanh Tam, according to a recent indictment. Authorities also seized VND44.8 billion in cash, equivalent to roughly 90 kilograms in Vietnam's highest-denomination banknotes, more than US$1.7 million, hundreds of thousands of dollars' worth of other foreign currencies and dozens of land-use-right certificates. Nam and his accomplices were arrested in 2024 for allegedly using fake forex and stock trading websites to lure people into depositing money, then manipulated the platforms to take their funds. Tam, 31, lived with Nam as his girlfriend and was entrusted with managing all money and assets obtained through crime. While Nam went on livestreams to give investment advice and lured victims into trading forex on his fraudulent platforms, Tam acted as his money manager, working behind the scenes with his parents to direct the flow of illicit funds. Prosecutors said that in October 2021, Nam told his girlfriend to contact his father, Pho Duc Thang, and ask him to find someone willing to be named as the person who registered a company. Thang borrowed the identity card of a colleague, took a photo of it and sent it to Tam to register South Wealth Real Estate. Tam also contacted Nam’s aunt, Nguyen Thi Thuy, and asked her to run Tech Invest, a company Nam had established. Nam instructed Tam and Thuy to use the two companies to buy and sell properties to conceal the origins of the illegally obtained money. Tam also held title to and directly managed some of the properties. Nam’s parents held title to others. The 32 properties were valued at VND378 billion. On the day Nam was arrested, his parents scrambled to withdraw VND115 billion to buy gold. His girlfriend, however, had been instructed to stockpile gold from the outset. According to the allegations, Nam gave Tam VND141 billion in cash to buy 78 one-kilogram gold bars, a nearly 6-kg gold block shaped like a cat, hundreds of other gold bars and pieces, Vietnamese dong and various foreign currencies. Nam’s parents, Tam and several of his cousins face money-laundering charges over the alleged conduct. Tam is accused of laundering VND384 billion. The indictment also details the role of Tam’s older brother, Nguyen Thanh Phong, a police officer who was part of a "legal advisory team" for Nam whenever employees were summoned by investigators or faced prosecution and trial. The team was paid VND6.4 billion, of which Phong received VND2.2 billion. Phong is also accused of pooling money with Nam to buy four plots of land in Tay Ninh. He faces an additional charge of property fraud. Another prominent figure accused of laundering large sums for Nam is Shark Tank investor Nguyen Hoa Binh, who allegedly laundered VND320 billion and received 1% to 2.5% of each deposit or withdrawal transaction involving victims’ money. Binh is also accused of helping Nam falsify reports whenever police sent official requests to verify funds held on the fraudulent Forex platforms. Regarding the Mr Pips’ frauds, investigators found victims losing about VND1.3 trillion in total, and charged 83 people in connection with the operation. Authorities seized $2.3 million in cash, about 280 kg of gold, 41 cars and seven motorbikes, and froze transactions involving 130 properties.

picked.t: 호치민시, 공립학교 영어교육 기준 대폭 강화...고교생 B2 목표
picked.body: 호치민시의 쩐다이응이아 영재학교 학생들이 영어교육을 받고 있다. 호치민시는 학생들이 영어를 학습하는 데 그치지 않고 실제 교과 학습과 의사소통에 활용할 수 있는 교육 환경을 확대한다는 목표다. (사진=뚜오이재) (호치민=베트남코리아타임즈) 반 린 (Van Linh) 기자 = 베트남 호치민시가 공립학교의 영어교육 수준을 대폭 끌어올리는 방안을 추진한다. 중학생은 유럽언어공통기준(CEFR) B1, 고등학생은 B2 수준의 영어 능력을 갖추도록 하고, 중·고등학교 교사 전원에게 영어 의사소통 능력을 요구하는 등 대학 졸업생에게 적용되는 기준을 넘어서는 교육모델을 도입할 계획이다. 호치민시 교육훈련국은 유치원부터 고등학교까지 적용할 고품질 학교의 평가 기준과 교육 서비스 운영 조건을 담은 초안에 대해 의견을 수렴하고 있다. 해당 방안은 시 인민위원회에 제출하기 위한 것으로, 현재 확정된 시행 규정은 아니다. 이번 방안은 일반적인 공립학교보다 우수한 교원과 교육 환경, 학업 성과를 갖춘 고품질 학교 모델을 구축하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 특히 외국어 능력과 디지털 역량, 과학·기술·공학·수학(STEM) 교육 등을 강화해 학생들의 국제 경쟁력을 높이겠다는 취지다.   중학생 B1·고교생 B2 목표…교사도 영어 역량 강화 초안에서 가장 눈에 띄는 부분은 학생들의 영어 능력 기준이다. 중학생은 CEFR B1, 고등학생은 B2 수준에 도달하도록 제안했다. 베트남의 대학 상당수가 졸업 요건으로 B1 수준을 적용하는 점을 고려하면, 고품질 고등학교 학생에게 대학 졸업 기준보다 높은 영어 능력을 요구하는 셈이다. B1은 일상적인 상황에서 주요 내용을 이해하고 의사소통할 수 있는 수준이며, B2는 비교적 복잡한 주제에 대해서도 독립적으로 대화하고 의견을 설명할 수 있는 수준이다. 중학교와 고등학교 교사는 모두 영어로 의사소통할 수 있어야 한다. 이 가운데 최소 30%는 베트남의 6단계 외국어 능력 체계에서 4단계 이상, 즉 CEFR B2에 해당하는 수준을 갖추도록 했다. 교원의 학력 기준도 높아진다. 중학교 교원의 최소 85%, 고등학교 교원의 최소 60%가 석사 또는 박사 학위를 보유하도록 제안했다. 일반적인 교원 자격 기준이 학사 학위인 것과 비교하면 고학력 교원 확보에 무게를 둔 것이다. 초등학교에서도 교원 전원이 영어를 능숙하게 구사하고, 이 가운데 30%는 영어로 수업할 수 있도록 하는 방안이 제시됐다. 통합교육 프로그램을 담당하는 교사는 B2 영어 자격을, 영어로 교과목을 가르치는 교사는 C1 이상의 자격을 갖추도록 했다.   학급당 학생 수 줄이고 국제 자격증 취득 지원 교육 환경과 학생들의 학업 성과에 대한 기준도 강화된다. 초등학교는 학급당 학생 수를 35명으로 제한하고 음악·미술·외국어·정보기술 수업을 위한 별도 교실을 마련하도록 했다. 학생의 최소 80%가 안전한 수영 교육을 받고, 최소 60%가 영어와 컴퓨터 분야의 국제 기준을 충족하거나 국제 자격증을 취득하도록 하는 목표도 포함됐다. 중학교와 고등학교는 학급당 학생 수를 30명으로 제한하고 하루 두 차례 수업을 운영하는 방안이 제시됐다. 모든 학생에게 안전한 수영과 익사 예방 교육을 제공하며, 학생의 절반이 국제 영어 자격증을 보유하도록 하는 목표도 담겼다. 진학 성과 역시 평가 기준에 포함된다. 중학교 졸업생 전원이 공립 고등학교 또는 국제교육 요소를 갖춘 학교에 진학하고, 고등학교 졸업생 전원이 베트남 내 대학·전문대학에 진학하거나 해외 유학을 하도록 제안했다. 다만 이 기준은 고품질 학교 모델에 적용하기 위해 제시된 것으로, 일반 공립학교 전체에 동일하게 요구되는 의무사항은 아니다. 유치원에서는 교원의 최소 70%가 학사 학위 이상을 보유하도록 하고, 영어를 접목한 교육과 문화 교류, 영어 독서 및 음악 활동 등을 통해 자연스럽게 외국어를 접할 수 있는 환경을 조성하도록 했다. 호치민시는 현재 일반 공립학교 외에도 유치원부터 고등학교까지 80개가 넘는 학교에서 선진·지역 및 국제통합 교육모델을 운영하고 있다. 해당 학교들의 교육비는 학생 1인당 월 170만동(약 66달러) 이상이다. 시 교육당국은 외국어와 디지털·인공지능(AI) 역량, STEM 교육 및 국제사회 적응 능력에 대한 학부모들의 기대가 높아지고 있다고 설명했다. 다만 고품질 학교 모델의 교육 서비스에 대한 비용 부담과 실제 교육 성과를 어떻게 확보할지는 향후 제도 설계 과정에서 중요한 과제가 될 전망이다.   <저작권자(c) 베트남코리아타임즈, 무단 전재-재배포 금지>
